data_processing: Array preprocessing was performed using the standard pipeline from the lumi package which is designed specifically for Illumina microarrays. Raw intensities were normalized using variance-stabilized transformation and interarray normalization was performed with robust spline normalization. Outliers were removed based upon sample-wise connectivity z-scores. Batch effect correction was performed using ComBat from the sva package. Probes were filtered by detection score P < 0.01 and unannotated probes were dropped. Duplicate probes for the same gene were dropped using the maxMean method with the collapseRows function from the WGCNA package, which only keeps probes with the highest mean expression across all of the samples.
series_overall_design: 1299 peripheral blood samples, of which 733 were used in study.  4 samples were run twice, but were not intended as technical replicates.  Sample status is indicates by characteristics: sample column and can be either patient, heterozygous carrier or control
series_title: Peripheral blood biomarkers in Friedreich's ataxia
